description: Delete a branch the way `git push --delete` would: write access, then branch protection (allow_deletion), rulesets and the push inspection apply; webhooks and CI fire. The default branch is never deleted. Pass expected_sha to delete only if the branch still points there. A missing branch is a not-found error. Mirrors DELETE /api/v3/repos/:o/:r/git/refs/heads/:branch. Audit-logged. Returns {branch, sha, deleted: true}.

expected_sha.description: Delete only if the branch still points here (compare-and-swap); otherwise a conflict

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_delete_branch
